title: Roadmap dependency orchestra and readiness lattice
creator: Lena Zhang
description: Create a cross-team dependency orchestration pattern (the 'orchestra') and a lightweight readiness lattice to track and automate cutover gating for roadmap initiatives. The goal is to reduce late-stage integration recalls by 40% for Q2 launches by giving PMs, Eng, Design, Security and Infra clear, machine-readable dependency states and actionable remediation lanes. Deliverables: readiness lattice schema, team onboarding playbook, automated gating rules for canary/cutover, and a lightweight dashboard that surfaces high-risk edges and slack windows.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness lattice schema published in Confluence with definitions for TIERS (Critical, High, Medium, Low) and STATES (Blocked, At Risk, On Track, Ready)
Automated gating rules implemented in the dashboard: if any Critical dependency is Blocked then cutover button is disabled and owner auto-notified
At least three pilot initiatives (one each from Eng infra, Security, and Design) onboarded to the lattice and evaluated during a staged cutover
Dashboard shows dependency slack windows and an aggregated risk score per initiative with < 30s refresh for RT data feeds
Runbook for escalations and fallback lanes documented and approved by Eng and Security leads
tasks: Draft lattice schema and field definitions (PM + Eng)
Prototype dashboard wireframe (Design) and gather feedback
Implement minimal API contract for dependency state (Eng)
Integrate Security signals (SAST/Approval gates) into lattice
Define cutover gating policy and feature-flag pattern
Post-pilot retro and iterate on gating thresholds
notes: 2026-02-17: Kickoff meeting — aligned on need for machine-readable states; agreed to keep initial schema intentionally small (8 fields).
2026-02-22: Design review — Aisha proposed a compact timeline view showing slack windows; agreed to include both per-dependency and initiative rollup scores.
2026-02-27: Eng spike found that existing events stream can emit dependency status with 2 additional tags; estimated 3 days to add API contract.
2026-02-28: Security flagged that SSO-linked approvals need audit logging; added security_review_required flag and audit endpoint to acceptance criteria.
Trade-offs discussed: Start with opt-in lattice per initiative (reduces blast radius) versus mandatory enforcement (higher coverage). We agreed opt-in pilot followed by policy recommendation.
Early decision: Use feature-flag gating for cutover enforcement to allow rollback without infra changes.
decisions: Use a small, extensible schema (tier + state + owner + expected-ready-date + slack_seconds + last-updated + evidence-url + mitigation-plan) to balance signal vs noise.
Gating enforcement will be implemented client-side in Console with an API-based authoritative source of truth; Console will block cutover UI and surface owner/contact.
Pilot will be opt-in for three initiatives; after pilot, recommend organization-wide adoption tied to release checklists.
Security approvals will be represented as dependency states (e.g., Security: Approval = Ready) rather than separate process to simplify rollups.
blockers: Need final sign-off from Security on audit retention policy for gating approvals
Infra capacity telemetry for slack calculations not yet available in events stream
Engineer allocation constrained by Q2 runtime performance sprint (Ravi only partial bandwidth)
followups: Schedule sign-off meeting with Security on 2026-03-05 (owner: Marco Reyes)
